name: qwen3b_long_context
description: Phase 6b: long-context KV-cache behaviour on the iGPU, where the 3B model is fast enough for 2k-8k prompts. Per-token KV for Qwen2.5-3B: 36 KiB at f16, so 8k tokens = 288 MiB; GPU default precision is chosen by the plugin; explicit u8 or f16 fails on this GPU (Finding 17), so only the default is run.
